Definition: from a compound of G4253 and G5316; an outward showing, i.e. pretext:--cloke, colour, pretence, show.
BiblicalUsage: Prophasis is a pretext, a cloak, a colour put over the truth. Jesus says the Pharisees have no cloak for their sin, because the light has come and they rejected it, and Paul rejoices that whether in pretence or in truth, Christ is preached.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God sees through every cloak, and even preaching done under a false colour cannot hide the Christ it names.
